title: AgenticTwin: An Agentic LLM Framework Integrated with Digital Twin for Anomaly Detection

claim.summary: AgenticTwin uses a digital-twin residual classifier to create structured fault events and routes them through retrieval, diagnosis, mitigation and supervision agents.

tasks.source_label: Anomaly detection and diagnosis; Decision support

modules.name: Digital-twin residual anomaly event generation
modules.scope_reason: Observed/predicted sensor values and residuals train a fault classifier and instantiate anomaly event records.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "The proposed anomaly classifier"

modules.name: Historical fault retrieval and grounded mitigation
modules.scope_reason: Agents consume fault types, residuals and a curated anomaly knowledge base to explain causes and recommend corrective actions.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "At the core of the AgenticTwin"
